parsed.label: Subsidiary Adjusted EBITDA

figures.quote: • Subsidiary adjusted EBITDA was $88.8 million, up 18.4% vs Q4 2024
• Subsidiary Adjusted EBITDA was $345.8 million, up 8.8% vs 2024

parsed.notes: The excerpt does not include the reconciliation table, so the consolidated Adjusted EBITDA (after corporate expense) is not shown. The figures reported are Subsidiary Adjusted EBITDA, the sum of all consolidated subsidiaries. It excludes Lugano and corporate expense, so it is a total-of-segments measure rather than consolidated Adjusted EBITDA. Prior-year amounts appear only as percentage changes (Q4 up 18.4%, full year up 8.8%), not as printed numbers, so they are not listed. Segment figures (Branded Consumer $219.7M, Industrial $126.1M) and the 2026 guidance ($345.0–$395.0M) are excluded.
